facts.business: Kewal Kiran Clothing Limited (KKCL) is an Indian lifestyle apparel company with an integrated fashion business across design, manufacturing, branding, distribution and retail, operating brands such as Killer, Integriti, Lawman, Easies, Junior Killer and Kraus Casuals.

segments.name: Men's casualwear (Killer, Lawman, Integriti, Easies, Junior Killer)

auditor.name: Jain & Trivedi, Chartered Accountants and N.A. Shah Associates LLP, Chartered Accountants
